description.value:
By elongating a Pulsar and replacing its autosear with electro-rails, Darra Polytechnic have made a surprisingly solid tech rifle. Plus, its rotating barrel-block provides effective firing at various ranges, making it ideal for bodyguards needing precision when engaging multiple targets from a defensive position. Some say the Equinox isn’t flashy or cyberlinked enough, and that its use case is too niche, but simplicity and specialization won’t stop it from punching a hole through somebody, so critics be damned.

Cost: 2,250eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Carbine / Battle Rifle

Damage: 5d6 • Capacity: 10 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Tech Rebuild, Telescopic Barrel (w/ Carbine Barrel & Battle Barrel) • Mods: None

Special Features: With 1 Minute, this weapon’s user can swap between either of its installed Range Table Modifications [Telescopic Barrel].

Range: Carbine / Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Tech Rebuild, Telescopic Barrel (w/ Carbine Barrel & Battle Barrel) (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Uses DV Carbine; change the item's DV table to DV Battle Rifle while the Battle Barrel is selected.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
